name: Important Windows Service Terminated With Error
description: Detects important or interesting Windows services that got terminated for whatever reason
author: GAI_CTI
false_positives: Rare false positives could occur since service termination could happen due to multiple reasons
query: winlog.channel:System AND ((winlog.provider_name:Service\ Control\ Manager AND event.code:7023) AND ((winlog.event_data.param1:(*\ Antivirus* OR *\ Firewall* OR *Application\ Guard* OR *BitLocker\ Drive\ Encryption\ Service* OR *Encrypting\ File\ System* OR *Microsoft\ Defender* OR *Threat\ Protection* OR *Windows\ Event\ Log*)) OR (winlog.event_data.Binary:(*770069006e0064006500660065006e006400* OR *4500760065006e0074004c006f006700* OR *6d0070007300730076006300* OR *530065006e0073006500* OR *450046005300* OR *420044004500530056004300*))))
